# Paul Irving

## Appearance

Paul Irving possesses features of exquisite delicacy and refinement. Previously framed by a halo of naturally curly chestnut or brown hair, his former curls have since given place to close-cropped brown locks by the age of sixteen. He also has very dark blue eyes.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P7](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0007), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P29](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0029), [v3 ch.People P13](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0013), [v3 ch.Revelation P2](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0002)_

## Personality

Paul Irving is a remarkably imaginative and clever child who is considered both a genius and a darling by those who know him. Exceptionally well-mannered, neat, and manly, he takes care of his hygiene voluntarily and holds his own well in games. He also demonstrates a protective, helpful nature toward younger students at school, defending them from older boys and teaching them games.

_Sources: [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P7](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0007), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P32](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0032), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P52](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0052), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P3](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0003), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P5](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0005), +1 more_

## History

Paul Irving moved from the [States](../codex/places.md#states) to live with his grandmother three years after his mother died. He became a pupil in [Anne](../character/anne.md) Shirley's classroom, quickly becoming her favorite student due to his bright intellect and vivid imagination. He shared his imaginative stories and rock friends with [Anne](../character/anne.md) through letters and personal conversations, finding comfort in her reassurance when others considered him strange. During a visit to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), Paul bonded with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) over their shared affinity for imaginary stories. He later discussed the romantic reunion and upcoming wedding of his father, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), and Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) with [Anne](../character/anne.md).

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P2](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0002), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P13](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0013), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P14](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0014), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P15](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0015), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P16](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0016), +419 more_

## Quotes

> "I’ve eaten enough to make anyone grow. I do hope, now that I’ve begun, I’ll keep on till I’m as tall as father. He is six feet, you know, Miss Lavendar."
>
> — Paul Irving — [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P24](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0024)

> "I think you would make a splendid mother. You have just the right look in your eyes . . . the look my little mother always had. I think it’s a pity you haven’t any boys of your own."
>
> — Paul Irving — [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P58](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0058)

> "you can’t think what has happened! Something so splendid. Father is here . . . just think of that! Father is here! Come right in. Father, this is my beautiful teacher. You know, father."
>
> — Paul Irving — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P21](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0021)

> "and I came back to give them to you because I thought you were the kind of lady that would like them, and because . . ."
>
> — Paul Irving — [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P21](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0021)

> “Yes; but if dryads are foolish they must take the consequences, just as if they were real people,” said Paul gravely. “Do you know what I think about the new moon, teacher? I think it is a little golden boat full of dreams.”
>
> — Paul Irving — [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P30](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0030)

## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--paul-irving.md)

[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) is Paul's schoolteacher and close friend. Their bond quickly forms over a mutual love for wild beauty and vibrant imagination, making Paul her favorite pupil. They share imaginative ideas, written compositions, and quiet walks together.

### [Grandma Irving](../character/grandma-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/grandma-irving--paul-irving.md)

[Grandma Irving](../character/grandma-irving.md) is Paul's strict grandmother who lives in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). While Paul respects her rules, his unique and untamed imagination remains a frequent topic of conversation among the local mothers.

- Relative of — grandmother  <sub>[v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P12](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0012), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P3](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0003), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P36](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0036), +4 more</sub>

### [Irving](../character/irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/irving--paul-irving.md)

[Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) is Paul's father. After being separated from his former love, Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) reconnects with her and eventually plans to marry her, a romantic turn of events that Paul discusses with [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md).

- Child of — father  <sub>[v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P22](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0022), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P45](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0045), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P1](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0001)</sub>

### [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lavendar-lewis--paul-irving.md)

Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) is a kindred spirit to Paul who lives at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). The two connect deeply through their shared, vivid imaginations, often spending time together in the garden recounting stories and sharing tales of their imaginary companions.

- Friend of — kindred spirits sharing stories and imagination in the garden  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P51](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0051)</sub>

### [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lynde--paul-irving.md)

Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) is an [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) resident who holds a fondness for Paul. She frequently takes an interest in the boy and comments on his exceptional imagination.

- Friend of — fond of the young boy  <sub>[v2 XI Facts and Fancies P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038)</sub>

### [Twin Sailors](../character/twin-sailors.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/paul-irving--twin-sailors.md)

The [Twin Sailors](../character/twin-sailors.md) are imaginary rock characters invented by Paul. He writes creative stories about them coming ashore from the sea to talk with him, though he explicitly acknowledges that they are not real.

- presumed Friend of — imaginary rock people who come ashore to talk with him  <sub>[v2 XI Facts and Fancies P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042)</sub>
